title: Ticker
description: 24-hour trading statistics for an asset pair.

bid.description: The current highest bid price level.

ask.description: The current lowest ask price level.

high.description: The highest price in the last 24 hours.

low.description: The lowest price in the last 24 hours.

volume.description: The trading volume in the last 24 hours (base asset).

daily_change.description: The price change in the last 24 hours (absolute value).

PriceLevel.description: A price level with quantity and order count.

quantity.description: The total quantity at this price level.

order_count.description: The number of orders at this price level.
